result.note: Tests the country where UPI went live in July 2026 as its tenth overseas market, a payments-system fact.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) went live in which European country, making it UPI's tenth overseas market?
questions.explain: UPI went live in Greece on 1 July 2026, which became its tenth overseas market. The launch extends India's run of exporting its payments system into another European economy.
questions.source: UPI went live in Greece, its tenth overseas market, extending India's payments-export run into another European economy.
